name: Suluan Damaged Lighthouse
blurb: A fixed Hangar-only damaged lighthouse silhouette with broken crown and displaced debris, without terrain dressing or emitted light.
history: Suluan sits at the eastern approach to Leyte Gulf and appears in Philippine navigational references. This campaign-state lighthouse is intentionally a fixed estimated damaged form rather than a reconstruction of a surviving architectural drawing.

sources.title: United States Coast Pilot, Philippine Islands
